page.overview:
Who is Burning Oak?

Burning Oak is a male lizardfolk druid and, as of 812 and 836 PD, was the 500-year-old leader of the Scions of Flame, a tribe of black-scaled lizardfolk ruling the Ashen Gorge. His magic is responsible for keeping the other tribes of the gorge at bay, but it is known to them that the druid's frailty makes him vulnerable to attack.

So far, Burning Oak has not appeared or been mentioned onstream.
